service.ur: جائیداد کی ملکیت کی معلومات میں تبدیلی (طاقہ)

about: Transfer or change the property owner details held for a utility account from one owner to another.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: No objection certificate signed by the other owners (if more than one owner)
Emirates ID of the other owners
Emirates ID of the agent (if applying through an agent)
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
